text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algerians vote on constitution: a new event to strengthen multi-party democracy.
- The government to open shipping services for private investors.
- Opposition party leader Said Saadi barred from holding a news conference in a government-controlled press center.
- Algeria's voters, urged by opposition to vote "No" or boycott, decide on Thursday on the fate of draft constitution.
